reason: The new CLAUDE.md guidance (CLAUDE.md:448-458) says to narrow a union type with isinstance() instead of hasattr(), and the patch does exactly that in the flusher. At flusher.py:303 (patch line 303), it narrows the `SpawnProcess | threading.Thread` union from `self.processes` (patch line 126) with `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` before calling `kill()`, so the guidance matches a pattern the flusher change uses.
